change: Port the story starter to Dewy with bookmarks before visible steps and saved backgrounds/characters, so a reopened line or choice is restored rather than skipped. Add project-derived story filenames and include the web input regression fixture in CI path filters.
validation: 30 focused starter/new-project checks passed in 11.97s using a compiler built from the previous core.
Two native saved-reading checks (default/release) passed in 4.12s.
Formatter, Ruff and git diff --check passed. Full independent C bootstrap is assigned to hosted CI for this increment.
coverage: Native/web, default/release: both choice branches to end, invalid choices, unchanged snapshots, branch variables, scene/show/hide commands, restart, bookmark resume and text serialization at every visible step.
Native/default/release: on_quit saves a displayed Mira line; a new process restores that same line, character position and square background using an isolated save directory.
Project filename sanitization/fallback, native software render and web build; included two project tests in both native modes.

Browser: Enter reveal/advance to choice, reload restores both choices and characters; clicking second choice displays Ren reply; reload repeats that reply with its characters/background. No console/network errors.
limits: Prototype portraits are circles and scenes are flat colors, as in the original starter; generated projects can replace them with images.
No claim of full RenPy language compatibility. Saving relies on the ordinary on_quit/pagehide hook; abrupt process/browser termination can lose the latest progress.
